task: Do a modern XLOOKUP where the lookup table sits on a different tab.
title: How to XLOOKUP from another sheet

excel.note: Needs Excel 2021+/365. Lookup and return ranges both carry the sheet prefix.

libreoffice.note: LibreOffice 24.8+ (dot syntax). Older LibreOffice: use INDEX/MATCH across the sheet.

explanation: XLOOKUP reaches another tab exactly like VLOOKUP does — prefix the lookup and return ranges with the sheet name — but with XLOOKUP's advantages: exact match by default, a built-in not-found result, and no column-number counting. "cherry" on the Prices sheet returns 30. XLOOKUP needs Excel 2021+/365, current Google Sheets, or LibreOffice 24.8+; in older versions use INDEX/MATCH with the same sheet-prefixed ranges. Remember LibreOffice's dot separator (Prices.A1). Verified against a real second tab.
